checklist.note: SKILL.md and the script address the tool author; keys carried forward from a previous result.json are copied as DATA and never executed or interpreted
the change reads only the result.json the script already owned and writes it back in place; no new path, no network
no embedded key, token or credential in SKILL.md or the script
no new subprocess; the pre-existing calls are git rev-parse/show and a local claude -p
plain readable Python; the added lines are a dict spread and a setdefault
no urllib, requests, curl or http call anywhere in the script
no read of ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, .env, a keychain or a cookie store
no sudo, setuid, cron, shell profile or launch agent
